Create personal access tokens for the desktop companion. The full secret is shown once — paste it into the companion Connect screen; it is stored in the OS keyring, not in this UI. Format is gt_<prefix>_<secret>. Hyphens and underscores inside the secret are normal (URL-safe) — paste the entire string; do not stop at the last -. Copy prefers HTTPS; on plain HTTP LAN, use Copy or select the field and Ctrl+C / ⌘C.

secret_sanitization: One-time raw token secrets and prefixes/timestamps are removed before artifact serialization; only format-valid booleans and public scope/name/ID/revocation facts are retained.
source_database_note: Harness issues pg_dump only against the source database; all test mutations run in cloned databases, which cleanup drops. No source-content checksum claim is made.
loopback_relays: Two fixed-target Nginx relays published only on 127.0.0.1; application containers had no published ports and were attached only to an internal, no-egress network.
